images.caption: Two Aberdeen butteries (also known as rowies) served with fruit preserve/jam, one cut in half to show interior. The Aberdeen buttery is a specialty of the city of Aberdeen, Scotland. images.caption:
On the North-west approach to Aberdeen (Dyce) airport in Scotland you get good views over the western suburbs of the city. On this particular day the low sun angle added to the shot.
When I zoomed into the original photo I could see, near the top of the grassed area, a woman walking an Alsation dog. Unfortunately on Flickr the definition is reduced.

At the time of taking the photo we would have been travelling at about 140 knots / 160 mph.
images.alt:
